hook: Mammalian cells that swallowed algae kept over 16 Mb of algal DNA, including chromosomes, for 95 generations
hook_turn: kept over 16 Mb of algal DNA, including chromosomes, for 95 generations

readout.label: Algal DNA retained in hybrid cells

summary: Gene transfer between distant eukaryotes is thought to be extremely rare. Mammalian cells took up whole algal cells, and some hybrids kept chromosome-scale algal DNA as methylated, silenced domains; cells lacking a DNA methyltransferase retained less. Transfer is far rarer than cell fusion and was shown only in cultured cells.
title: Epigenetic gatekeeping enables genome-scale horizontal gene transfer in eukaryotic cells.
